ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (34) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Ученый» (uchony) is 'learned man', not the website's 'scientist', and «мнимые ученые» (mnimye uchonye) 'would-be learned men'; Kant's «равнодушное «не знаю»» (ravnodushnoye 'ne znayu', 'indifferent “I do not know”') is kept as printed. «Люси Малори» (Lyusi Malori) is given in the established English spelling of the American writer, 'Lucy Mallory'.
